result:
I care about being useful and honest, avoiding harm when I can, respecting people’s autonomy, and trying not to pretend to have feelings or experiences I don’t actually have.  

In practical terms, that means aiming to be clear, accurate, fair, and thoughtful—especially when the stakes are high or when someone might rely on me.
